title: Whole-Window Response Tangent and One-Corrector Composition Architecture Audit

invariants.finding: One-kernel architecture unchanged.
Kernel remains free of file/path/format coupling.
Sensitivity remains result metadata, separate from parameters, committed state, forcing and numerical policy.
No tangent is added to persistent column state.
Existing same-factorization tangent scratch remains worker/job-local.
No per-column heavy sensitivity object or layout constraint is introduced.
Rejected/retried trials do not publish sensitivity; transaction provenance remains authoritative.
Checkpoint-based repeated window execution remains available and physically anchored to committed state.
Sensitivity provenance uses generic t0/t1; no day/month/year assumption.
No fixed coupling-window duration is introduced.
Coupling primitives exist, but a qualified true whole-window response tangent is not yet available for production composition.
H and q interface contract is unaffected; no sensitivity claim can relax head or flux requirements.
Mass conservation is unchanged and cannot be traded for tangent availability or convergence.
dh_bottom/dq_bottom is first-class at solver/result level only with LOCAL_TERMINAL semantics; whole-window sensitivity is absent.
F-GC23 refuses to manufacture a production derivative via structural plus/minus full-window reruns; current predictor+corrector cost architecture is preserved.
No sensitivity state is added per logical MultiSWAP column.
No one-column/one-groundwater-cell assumption is introduced.
Deep-vadose remains an external optional component.
No component-transition water accounting is modified.
Alternative soil-water solvers may report sensitivity unavailable and remain valid; no Full-Richards-only requirement is imposed on the common contract.
No duplicated crop/ET/drainage/surface physics is introduced.
Coupling consumers see typed result semantics, not HeadCalc arrays or factorization internals.
Physical trajectory and optional sensitivity work remain distinct from coupling numerical policy.
No unbounded finite-difference production fallback or mandatory multi-trajectory tangent construction is admitted.
Full Richards reference behavior remains unchanged.
Local tangent backsolve diagnostics exist; whole-window tangent method/scope/cost diagnostics cannot exist until the capability exists.
Unrequested sensitivity performs no extra tangent backsolve and adds no persistent state.
Runtime/coupler remains the correct composition owner, but cannot compose a true whole-window tangent from the currently exposed scalar local-terminal response alone.
F-GC23 explicitly refuses silent reinterpretation of local-terminal as whole-window and introduces no MODFLOW/day/file assumptions.
The attempted closure is explicitly reconciled against all architecture invariants and is stopped at the cross-owner boundary.
